blocks.text: Transition elements bohat se chemical reactions mein achhe catalysts hain. Yeh apni alag alag stable oxidation states mein aasani se badal jate hain (maslan Fe²⁺ ⇌ Fe³⁺). Is se metal ion reactant molecule ke saath ek unstable intermediate (beech ka) compound bana leta hai. Yeh intermediate jaldi react kar ke final product deta hai aur catalyst apni asal oxidation state mein wapas aa jata hai. Is tarah reaction ko kam activation energy wala raasta mil jata hai. Yeh aam tor par homogeneous catalysis (catalyst aur reactants ek hi phase mein) mein hota hai. Misal: acetylene se acrylic acid banane mein nickel salts use hote hain, jin mein Ni(0) aur Ni(II) oxidation states kaam aati hain.

Transition metals ki doosri property (khoobi) in ke khaali d-orbitals hain jo energy ke lihaz se accessible (pohanch mein) hain. Reactant molecules catalyst ki surface (satah) se jur kar ek temporary (aarzi) activated complex banate hain, jo reactants ko sahi orientation (rukh) mein pakar kar activation energy kam kar deta hai. Reaction ke baad products surface se alag (desorb) ho jate hain aur catalyst agle chakkar ke liye tayyar hota hai. Yeh aam tor par heterogeneous catalysis (catalyst ka phase alag) mein hota hai. Mashhoor misal Haber Process hai, jahan solid iron nitrogen aur hydrogen se ammonia banne ka reaction tez karta hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Vanadium +2 se +5 tak oxidation states kaise dikha sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: V [Ar] 3d³4s² hai. 3d aur 4s ki energy qareeb hone se yeh pehle do 4s electrons (+2) aur phir ek, do ya teen 3d electrons (+3, +4, +5) kho sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Complex ion banne mein ligand ka kya role (kirdar) hai, aur kaun sa bond banta hai?
blocks.explanation: Ligand metal ion ko electrons ka lone pair deta hai; is se coordinate covalent (dative) bond banta hai.

blocks.prompt: c) Transition metals bonding mein 4s aur 3d dono electrons kyun use karte hain, s-block elements ke ulat?
blocks.explanation: In ke 3d aur 4s subshells ki energy bohat qareeb hai, is liye 3d electrons bhi taqreeban 4s ki tarah aasani se nikalte hain; s-block elements mein andar ke electrons bohat kam energy par hain aur bonding mein use nahi hote.

blocks.prompt: d) Fe³⁺ ki configuration likhein. Fe²⁺/Fe³⁺ ki tabdeeli catalysis mein kyun useful hai?
blocks.explanation: Fe³⁺ = [Ar] 3d⁵. Iron aasani se +2 aur +3 ke darmiyan badalta hai, is liye ek reactant se electron le kar doosre ko de sakta hai aur phir apni asal oxidation state mein aa jata hai.

blocks.prompt: e) Transition metals ki kaun si properties inhein heterogeneous aur homogeneous catalysts banati hain?
blocks.explanation: Heterogeneous: khaali, accessible d-orbitals jo reactants ko metal ki surface se temporary jorte hain. Homogeneous: variable oxidation states jo ion ko intermediate compounds banane aur torne dete hain.

items: Homogeneous catalysis: oxidation state ki tabdeeli (Fe²⁺ ⇌ Fe³⁺; Ni(0)/Ni(II)).
Heterogeneous catalysis: khaali d-orbitals surface par reactants jorte hain (Haber Process mein solid iron).
